note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the part is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye. Quran pictures (Obay, 2026-11-22): the Prophet Muhammad is never shown in any way, nor anyone standing in for him; God is never pictured; no religious symbols of any tradition (no mosque, minaret, dome, crescent, Arabic writing or copy of the Quran); nothing violent. The text's own images (fire, storm, rain, gardens, the gnat) are shown as they are. Wide pictures only. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse; the first scene starts with the surah's opening line. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words.

sections.meaning: This Book, beyond doubt, is guidance for those mindful of God: who trust the unseen, keep up prayer, give from what they were given and are sure of what is to come; they are the ones who succeed.
ideas: A lighthouse beam sweeps across the night sea, showing a small fishing boat the safe way into harbor
Hikers at dusk follow their guide's lamp along a narrow cliff path
Steady hands holding a glowing compass on the deck of a boat at night
Two pairs of hands at a doorway: one passes a basket of fresh bread and fruit to the other
A farmer hands full sacks of his harvest to neighbors at the edge of his field
A seed pressed into dark soil by a hand, trusting what it cannot see yet
A woman sets aside part of her family's meal into a box for a neighbor
A climber clipped to a fixed rope reaches a sunlit summit
A runner crossing a finish line with arms raised
A row of trail markers lit up across a dark moor, leading home

sections.meaning: Those who refuse will not believe whether they are warned or not: their hearts and hearing are sealed and their sight is covered.
ideas: A man on a bench faces a glorious sunrise over the sea, but his hood is pulled down over his eyes and big headphones cover his ears
A house with its doors and windows boarded up and sealed while bright day shines outside
A man asleep in a hammock while storm flags fly and dark clouds roll in
A letter sealed with wax, never opened, gathering dust
A person with hands pressed over both ears and eyes squeezed shut
A heavy closed iron door in full sunlight
A man walks past a flashing warning beacon staring at his phone
Shutters bolted tight against the morning light
Frosted glass hiding a beautiful view
A brick wall built across a window

sections.meaning: Some say 'we believe' but do not: they deceive only themselves, call their corruption 'setting things right', mock in secret, and trade guidance away for error at a total loss.
ideas: Two men shake hands smiling while one hides crossed fingers behind his back
A man alone at night playing cards against himself slides a hidden card from his sleeve
A man smiling into a mirror while holding a smiling mask
A man in a suit plants a tiny sapling for a photo in front of a vast clear-cut forest of stumps
A pipe pours black waste into a clear river while a worker gives a thumbs-up
A man nods politely to one group while winking to another behind his back
On a dark road a man hands over his lit lantern in exchange for a handful of shiny coins
A man clutching glittering coins stands lost in a dark forest
A traveler swaps his compass for a cheap gaudy watch at a roadside stall
A man painting over a deep crack in a crumbling wall

sections.meaning: They are like a man whose fire goes out, leaving him blind in the dark, and like people caught in a night storm who step forward only while the lightning flashes.
ideas: A campfire just died in a dark forest, thin smoke rising, a man beside it unable to see
A man holds up a lantern whose flame has just gone out, smoke curling from it
A man in pitch darkness with his arms stretched out, feeling his way
A man on a dark country road in heavy rain covers his ears as lightning lights the road ahead
Lightning splits a black sky over a flooded road where a few people stand frozen mid-step
People huddled under a tree in thunder, fingers in their ears
A car's headlights fail on a night road in the rain
A city in a power cut during a storm
Thunderclouds piling over a plain at night
A walker frozen on a mountain path as the lightning fades

sections.meaning: Serve your Lord, who made you, spread the earth like a bed, built the sky, and sends rain that brings out fruit to feed you; set up no rivals to him.
ideas: Rain falling on a sunlit orchard heavy with ripe fruit under a vast sky
A farmer laughing in the rain holds up a basket of fresh fruit
Raindrops on ripe pomegranates on the branch
A wide green valley spread out under a huge sky with rain sweeping across it
A family picking fruit together after rain
A desert blooming with flowers after a storm
A river watering fields that stretch to the horizon
A dome of blue sky over a flat plain of wheat
Seedlings pushing up after the first rain
A table spread with fresh fruit beside an open window and rain

sections.meaning: If you doubt this message, make one like it; you never will, so guard yourselves against the Fire.
ideas: A desk littered with crumpled pages around one blank sheet and a pen, the chair pushed back
A writer at a desk at night, head in hands, a wastebasket overflowing with crumpled pages
A blank page with a pen lying untouched on it
A field of glowing lava and burning stones at night
Red-hot stones heaped in a roaring fire, flames leaping in the dark
A volcano's mouth glowing in the night
A tall fence keeping people back from a great fire
A man stepping back from a wall of heat
An archer's many arrows scattered far from the target
A sculptor's failed copies of a statue lying in a heap

sections.meaning: Good news for those who believe and do good: gardens with rivers flowing beneath, fruit they will know, pure spouses, and life there forever.
ideas: A lush garden with clear streams flowing beneath fruit trees in golden light
An old married couple walking hand in hand through a garden of streams and fruit trees
Ripe fruit hanging over a clear stream
A waterfall falling into a green garden pool
A table of fruit under trees beside a river
A young couple resting under a fruit tree by a stream
A gate opening onto a sunlit garden
Children drinking from a clear spring
An endless garden path under blossoming trees
Golden evening light on a riverside orchard

sections.meaning: God is not too proud to use even a gnat as an example; the faithful see the truth in it, while the defiant, who break their word and cut what should be joined, are led astray by it.
ideas: A tiny gnat on a dewy green leaf in sunlight, seen up close
A girl looks through a magnifying glass at a tiny gnat on a leaf, amazed
A gnat beside an elephant's eye, small beside great
A cloud of tiny gnats lit in a sunbeam
A rope bridge over a gorge cut through, its two halves hanging
A torn family photograph, the two halves lying apart on a table
Scissors cutting through a knotted rope
A signed paper torn in two
A broken chain link lying in the dust
A handshake pulling apart

sections.meaning: How can you deny God? You were lifeless and he gave you life; he will give death and life again, and to him you return; he made all on earth for you and formed the seven heavens.
ideas: Green shoots breaking up through dry cracked earth after rain
A father's large hand holding a newborn's tiny hand
A bare winter tree budding in spring
A grandfather and newborn grandchild together
An old man walking toward the sunset on a long road
The Milky Way arching over mountains and a still lake
Layers of twilight sky above wide hills, deepening into stars
The whole earth's riches: fields, forests and sea in one view
A seed splitting open in the soil
Stars over a sleeping valley

scenes.principle: That is the Book. There is no doubt in it; it is guidance.
scenes.shows: A lighthouse beam sweeps across the night sea, showing a small fishing boat the safe way into harbor.
scenes.prompt: At night on a rough dark sea, a tall white lighthouse on a rocky point sends a bright clear beam across the water. In the beam a small fishing boat with its own little lamp is steering safely between the rocks toward the calm harbor behind the point. Stars and a few clouds above. The lighthouse, its beam and the boat are in the upper two thirds of the picture; the dark water fills the bottom.

scenes.principle: Those who believe in the unseen, keep up the prayer, and spend from what we have provided for them.
scenes.shows: Two pairs of hands at a doorway: one passes a basket of fresh bread and fruit to the other.
scenes.prompt: Close view at the open door of a simple apartment in warm morning light: one person's hands hold out a woven basket full of fresh round bread, oranges, grapes and vegetables, and an older neighbor's hands reach to receive it. Only the hands, the forearms in plain everyday sleeves and the basket are seen, with the doorway behind. Generous and warm. The basket and the hands are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: It is the same for them whether you warn them or not. God has set a seal on their hearts and their hearing, and over their sight is a covering.
scenes.shows: A man on a bench faces a glorious sunrise over the sea, but his hood is pulled down over his eyes and big headphones cover his ears.
scenes.prompt: A man sits alone on a bench on a cliff top facing a glorious sunrise over the sea, golden light pouring over the water toward him. But the hood of his sweatshirt is pulled down over his eyes and big closed headphones cover his ears; he sees and hears none of it. Seen from the side. The man, his covered eyes and ears, and the sunrise he misses are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Some say, 'We believe in God and in the Last Day,' but they are not believers. They try to deceive.
scenes.shows: Two men shake hands smiling while one hides crossed fingers behind his back.
scenes.prompt: Two men in plain everyday clothes shake hands warmly and smile at each other in a sunny street. Seen from slightly behind one of them, his other hand is held behind his back with the fingers crossed, hidden from the other man. The handshake, the smiles and the crossed fingers behind his back are all clearly visible in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: When they are told, 'Do not cause corruption on the earth,' they say, 'We are only setting things right.'
scenes.shows: A man in a suit plants a tiny sapling for a photo in front of a vast clear-cut forest of stumps.
scenes.prompt: A man in a neat business suit kneels and plants one tiny sapling, smiling proudly at a photographer's camera. Behind him stretches a vast hillside of freshly cut tree stumps, mud and machine tracks where a whole forest has been cleared, under a grey sky. The man, the tiny sapling and the ruined hillside behind him are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: They wander blindly. They have bought error in exchange for guidance, so their trade has made no profit, and they were not guided.
scenes.shows: On a dark road a man hands over his lit lantern in exchange for a handful of shiny coins.
scenes.prompt: On a dark country road at night, a traveler hands over his glowing lantern, the only light anywhere, to a shadowy trader, and takes in return a handful of cheap glittering coins. The road ahead of the traveler disappears into blackness. The lantern changing hands, the coins and the traveler's face are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Like one who kindled a fire, and when it lit up what was around him, God took away their light and left them in darkness, unable to see.
scenes.shows: A campfire just died in a dark forest, thin smoke rising, a man beside it unable to see.
scenes.prompt: Night in a forest clearing. A campfire has just gone out: only a few dull red embers remain and a thin twist of white smoke rises from them. A man stands beside it with his arms stretched out, unable to see; the trees around him are fading into deep darkness, only the edge of his face and hands faintly lit by the last glow. The dead fire, the smoke and the man are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: A rainstorm with darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears; whenever it lights up for them, they walk in it, and when it grows dark, they stand still.
scenes.shows: A man on a dark country road in heavy rain covers his ears as lightning lights the road ahead.
scenes.prompt: A dark country road at night in pouring rain. A sudden bolt of lightning lights up the whole road and the fields ahead in harsh white light. A man in a soaked jacket, caught in the open, presses his fingers into his ears against the thunder and takes a step forward in the flash. The lightning, the lit road and the man are in the upper two thirds of the picture. No buildings.

scenes.principle: Worship your Lord, who made the earth a bed for you and the sky a building, and sent down water from the sky and with it brought out fruits as provision for you.
scenes.shows: Rain falling on a sunlit orchard heavy with ripe fruit under a vast sky.
scenes.prompt: A wide orchard of fruit trees heavy with ripe red and golden fruit, in a broad green valley. A shower of rain falls across it from a towering cloud, while sunlight breaks through behind, making the raindrops and wet leaves shine. A huge open sky above. Generous and alive. The fruit trees, the falling rain and the sky are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: If you are in doubt about what we have sent down, then bring a surah like it, if you are telling the truth.
scenes.shows: A writer at a desk at night, head in hands, a wastebasket overflowing with crumpled pages.
scenes.prompt: A man sits at a desk late at night under a single lamp with his head in his hands, defeated, in front of a blank sheet of paper. Beside him a wastebasket overflows with crumpled pages and more lie on the floor. No writing is visible on any paper. The man, the blank page and the crumpled pages are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Guard yourselves against the Fire whose fuel is people and stones.
scenes.shows: Red-hot stones heaped in a roaring fire, flames leaping in the dark.
scenes.prompt: A great roaring fire in the dark, its flames leaping high, fed by a heap of stones that glow red-hot and white-hot at the center. Sparks fly up into the black night. Fearsome and intense. No people or animals. The flames and the glowing stones are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Gardens with rivers flowing beneath them; there they have purified spouses, and there they will remain forever.
scenes.shows: An old married couple walking hand in hand through a garden of streams and fruit trees.
scenes.prompt: An elderly married couple in plain everyday clothes walk slowly hand in hand, seen from behind, along a path through a lush garden where clear streams flow beneath fruit trees heavy with ripe fruit, in warm golden light. Peaceful and lasting. The couple, the trees and the streams are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: A gnat or anything above it. Those who believe know that it is the truth from their Lord.
scenes.shows: A girl looks through a magnifying glass at a tiny gnat on a leaf, amazed.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny garden a girl of about ten holds a magnifying glass up to a leaf and looks through it, amazed, at a tiny gnat sitting on the leaf, which is seen large and sharp through the glass. Her face shows wonder. The magnifying glass, the gnat and her face are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Those who cut what God has commanded to be joined, and cause corruption on the earth.
scenes.shows: A torn family photograph, the two halves lying apart on a table.
scenes.prompt: On a plain wooden table lies an old family photograph that has been torn right down the middle, the two halves lying apart: on one half parents, on the other half their grown children, their faces too small to make out. A pair of scissors lies beside them. Plain sad light from a window. The two torn halves and the gap between them are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: You were dead and he gave you life, then he will cause you to die, then he will give you life.
scenes.shows: Green shoots breaking up through dry cracked earth after rain.
scenes.prompt: Close view of dry, cracked, dead brown earth after a rain: bright green shoots are breaking up through the cracks, fresh and full of life, with drops of water on them, in clear morning light. The shoots rising from the dead ground are in the upper two thirds of the picture; the cracked earth fills the bottom.

scenes.principle: He created for you all that is on the earth, then turned to the sky and formed them into seven heavens.
scenes.shows: The Milky Way arching over mountains and a still lake.
scenes.prompt: A clear night: the Milky Way arches across the whole sky in countless stars, above dark mountains and a perfectly still lake that mirrors the stars. Vast, deep and silent. The arch of stars and the mountains are in the upper two thirds of the picture; the lake fills the bottom.
